title: ASCII Phosphor Terminal: An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: Idea lights up in density bands
scenes.purpose: Show the idea as a light-bulb silhouette built only from fixed-width glyphs, cells stepping up the density ramp band by band.
visuals: Bulb cells replaced ' .:-=+*#%@' in registered two-row bands from base to crown
Density legend and 'density band n/5' label tracking progress
Title typed on its solid panel

beats.development: Prompt types and the rule sweeps across the grid.
Title types; bulb bands climb the glyph ramp with phosphor ghosts of previous glyphs fading out.
captions: AN IDEA BECOMES A CONNECTED SYSTEM

scenes.title: Idea connects into a system
scenes.purpose: Transfer the idea through an ASCII arrow into a network that grows link by link, then hold the finished system.
visuals: Arrow shaft '=======' draws cell by cell; '>' head appears only after the shaft completes
Network grows outward from the entry node, each cell passing '.' ':' '+' before its final link glyph
Nodes settle to foreground white, '[ok]' confirms

beats.development: Arrow shaft draws, then its head appears.
Connected system grows by BFS depth through density bands; '[ok]' types at 2.3 s.
Completed bulb, arrow, network and title hold stable.
captions: AN IDEA BECOMES A CONNECTED SYSTEM

findings: Builds are brisk (cell steps 34-40 ms); composition fully settled by 2.42 s.
justifiedHolds: 2.42-3.0 s single stable hold of the completed shape, as the style requires; title has been fully legible since about 1.0 s.

notes: Recipe demonstrated: build a recognisable silhouette by replacing character cells from one density band to the next (bulb by registered row bands, network by link depth).
All state derives from GSAP timeline time; redraws on every seek.
